angle: Exported function removal with single cross-file consumer within the same package
difficulty_notes: MarkUnionDeclarative is exported from the validators package, creating the impression of a wide blast radius. Models may scan for callers across the entire repository. The key is that only validators/native.go calls it — and even within the validators package, only native.go is the consumer. zeroorone.go has a parallel MarkZeroOrOneOfDeclarative function (which native.go also calls), but zeroorone.go does NOT call MarkUnionDeclarative. Models must correctly identify that union.go itself is not a consumer of MarkUnionDeclarative (it only defines it).
